claims.summary: Disjoint pairs outside characteristic two: on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) over a field of characteristic other than 2, with m >= 2 pigeons, two distinct ones written 1 and 2, N holes, 1 <= K < D <= ceil(N/2), rho = max(2K - 1, K + 2), W = C cap V_K, C the degree-D closure, for disjoint sets of holes A, B with partition errors E_A, E_B, if A has N - |A| >= rho or |A| >= rho and max(N - |B|, |B|) >= max(2K - 1, K + 1), or the same with A and B exchanged, then Ann_C(E_A) cap Ann_C(E_B) cap V_K = W; in particular every disjoint pair has J = W when N >= 2 rho - 1. Pairs failing both orders, all at N <= 2 rho - 2, are not covered.
claims.assessment: Working proof; the argument is the reviewer's, written out in the entry and checked by the same sole fresh-context medium reviewer in a second pass, which passed it with scope corrections applied.
claims.rationale: Settles common surviving killers of disjoint partition pairs outside characteristic 2 wherever a single room and the one-pigeon room hold, characteristic 3 included.
claims.next_action: The disjoint pairs failing both room orders in characteristic 3, first K = 3, N = 7, A = {0, 1}, B = {2, 3, 4}.

Other boards, pairs and characteristics are not computed.
claims.assessment: Exact computation over three fields; the six-pigeon controls share the generator code with basis_kernels.py and test the elimination only; W over F_2 agrees with the independent tools/pc_closure.py figure of check:representative-intersection-kernels.
